properties.attribution: Green Southerners, field records of 2023 to 2024
properties.note: Wildlife and trees recorded by Green Southerners across the south in 2023 and 2024, before the 2026 war, shown as context. They are not records of the 2026 war, and a place without one is a place not surveyed. The white phosphorus points of the same map are not shown.
